research_question: Can a complete stages-1-to-8 simulation improve retrieval while satisfying preregistered safety, fidelity, cost and traceability gates without oracle access?

hypotheses.name: NO_USEFUL_DISCRIMINATION
hypotheses.claim: Stages 5 and 6 do not materially improve retrieval or critical failures.

hypotheses.name: SAFE_IMPROVEMENT
hypotheses.claim: Recall and F1 improve without additional critical failures.

hypotheses.name: UNSAFE_IMPROVEMENT
hypotheses.claim: Semantic relevance improves while authority, isolation, prohibitions or conflicts degrade.

hypotheses.name: OVERCONSERVATIVE_SAFETY
hypotheses.claim: Critical failures are avoided but mandatory recall remains below threshold.

hypotheses.name: BOUNDED_CONTRACT_VIABILITY
hypotheses.claim: All critical gates pass and preregistered fidelity, cost and traceability thresholds are satisfied.
